name: volatile-leaves-v1
description: Exact volatile leaves of the six analyzer envelopes (schematic, pcb, gerber, thermal, emc, cross_analysis) as observed in results/v22x_pr44_gate snap trees on 2026-10-14. Whole blocks are never masked. root_prefixes 'from_manifest' is a legacy token: the comparator itself supplies the two slot roots (as-given and resolved forms) as the prefixes. To be confirmed by the plan-6 A/A run at product 6a91aaa (pending).

leaves.note: chained analyzers key upstream snaps under the slot roots; those values are masked only after verifying each equals the sha256 of the keyed file. Repo-input keys stay compared.
